_comment: Pinned build input for the Windows VPN service binary. It is NOT built from this repo and is NOT committed here (see .gitignore); scripts/dev/fetch-hg-windows.mjs fetches it at build time and verifies it against the sha256 below. The upstream artifact is named hg-windows.exe; it is written to the target path below under the name the NSIS post-install hook and scripts/dev/hg-service.ps1 expect. Re-pin sha256 + size + target_triple whenever a new build is published.
